articles.summary: 35,836 vehicles were delivered in August 2026, increasing by 14.5% year-over-year 262,893 vehicles were delivered year-to-date in 2026, increasing by 57.9% year-over-year Cumulative deliveries reached 1,260,485 as of August 31, 2026 SHANGHAI, Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- NIO Inc.
